title: URL Shortener
prompt: Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly. Users submit a long URL and get back a short link (e.g. sho.rt/aZ3kQ9). Visiting the short link redirects to the original URL. Optionally users can pick a custom alias and set an expiry.
functionalReqs: Create a short URL from a long URL
Redirect a short URL to the original long URL
nonFunctionalReqs: Highly available: redirects must keep working
Short codes must be unique and not easily guessable
outOfScope: User accounts and link management UI
deepDives: ID generation: counter + base62 vs hashing vs pre-generated key service
Cache-aside on the redirect path and cache sizing (80/20)
Handling expiry and custom alias collisions
rubricFocus: Collision-free code generation with a clear strategy
Choice of datastore justified by access pattern (key lookups)
